text: OVERDOSAGE In the event of overdosage, discontinue infusions containing sodium phosphate immediately and institute corrective therapy to restore depressed serum calcium and to reduce elevated serum sodium levels. (see WARNINGS , PRECAUTIONS and ADVERSE REACTIONS )
